EC4: patients included in another interventional clinical study involving infections or antibiotics and having the same primary parameter,
EC6: situation in which the procalcitonin concentration could be increased without correlation to an infectious process (poly-traumatised patients,
EC7: surgical interventions within the last 4 days,
EC10: immunodepressed patients (bone marrow transplant patients  [OR], patients with severe neutropenia),
EC11: patients with an absolute indication [AND] for administration of antibiotics at the moment of ICU admission (meningitis [OR], pneumonia) or a chronic infection [AND] for which long-term antibiotic treatment is necessary (endocarditis, osteo-articular infections, mediastinitis, deep abscesses, pneumocystis infection, toxoplasmosis, tuberculosis)
